raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / NEW DEVELOPMENTS / JHILLS - APPARTAMENTI INDIPENDENTI CON GIARDINO PRIVATO NEW DEVELOPMENT · APARTMENT JHILLS - Appartamenti Indipendenti con Giardino Privato JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €255,000 Photos (15) Floor plans (1) 1 / 15 FLOOR AREA 84 m² BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 1 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview JHILLS – Your independent space, your idea of home! ** LAST UNIT AVAILABLE ** Inspired by the iconic American hills where each residence represents an oasis of privacy, freedom, and personal space, JHILLS was born. It is a new residential project designed for those who are not looking for just an apartment but an authentic living experience, where privacy and modern comfort blend in an intimate setting of only 5 housing units, ensuring tranquility and value. With delivery expected in Spring 2027, this construction site represents the ideal opportunity for anyone wishing to see their custom home come to life while enjoying the highest contemporary building standards. The design of the spaces focuses on brightness and daily livability. Each unit features a smart layout: a spacious and welcoming living area with open kitchen, perfect for hosting guests and spending time together, accompanied by two half bedrooms and a bathroom finished down to the smallest details. The true strength of JHILLS lies in its complete independence: each apartment has its own private entrance as well as a generous garden conceived as a natural extension of the living room where you can enjoy moments of relaxation outdoors. Completing the property is dedicated parking space. > Strategic location and customized options; Located on tranquil Ca’ Gamba street which offers excellent services, JHILLS provides the perfect balance between the privacy of a residential neighborhood and convenient proximity to all major amenities. >> As it is an ongoing project, you will have the extraordinary opportunity to truly make your home yours through total customization: you can choose and shape every single detail from materials for coverings to colors of finishes up until final furnishing solutions. >>> Already own property? To make your transition into your new home at JHILLS easy-going without worries we offer dedicated swap management service that will assist you in selling your current property with maximum transparency and speed.
